description.en: Loads a light setup file (.xk) as an object and returns its handle; the skill scenes load one per scene. Wait with WaitLoading, check CMND_IS_BUILD_LIGHT, show it with CMND_SET_ENABLE and delete it with CMND_DELETE_LIGHT.
Light file, e.g. an archive path ending in "lgt.xk".

Handle of the light object.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: A skill scene's lights (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
